listing.name: Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo’s Dungeon (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed Wii disc preparation on Windows and a windowed upstream source build on Linux.

steps.title: Prepare the Windows player
steps.instruction: Keep the Windows x64 package files together, with its DLLs beside chocobo.exe. Place your own NTSC-U R7FEGD ISO or CISO in that folder, or supply the matching extracted sys and files under extracted. Start chocobo.exe and allow the upstream extraction to finish.

steps.title: Build the windowed Linux player from your original
steps.instruction: Follow the tagged upstream build instructions. Obtain sys/main.dol from your own matching extracted disc and run the documented Python recompilation into a clean gen directory. Build the windowed USE_SDL=ON target with CMake, Ninja, a C++17 compiler, SDL2 and OpenGL development libraries.

steps.title: Keep each profile with its actual root
steps.instruction: Use the upstream player with the matching extracted sys and files. With the standard layout preserve extracted, nand and chocobo.ini beside the creating runtime. The Windows player also accepts an explicit extracted-folder path, where save placement can follow that external root. Preserve the actual data locations before switching layouts.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
The Linux instructions cover the windowed source route. The upstream headless EGL test build is a separate target.
